name: Angelica Garcia
office: Valle Lindo School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Angelica Garcia is listed as a high school counselor on the county's candidate list for the Valle Lindo School District Governing Board. Her campaign website says she will push for updated classrooms, improved campus safety, and long-term facilities planning. She also states on her site that she wants to increase parent and community involvement in board decisions and advocate for teacher pay, professional development, and classroom resources.
